note: Each car's real-world surface character, read off its concept sheet (D:/RaceUltimate/concept-*.{jpg,png}) and the car it is modelled on. Colour stays the team's (teams.json); this is what the paint is made of. paint: 'solid' (deep wet gloss, no flake), 'metallic' (flake: 0..1 how grainy, flakeMm: flake size in mm, coarser reads more 'grainy'), 'pearl' (pearl: 0..1 iridescent shift). carbonBelow: exposed carbon weave below this fraction of the body's height (sills, splitter, diffuser; 0 = none). rim / caliper: wheel colours.

av12.why: V12 flagship: coarse grainy graphite metallic over hard creases, exposed carbon aero, yellow calipers, black forged wheels

mp1x.why: P1-style hypercar: deep sparkling metallic, carbon sills and diffuser, orange calipers

aston-martin-valk.why: Valkyrie: a carbon tub with bare weave across the lower body, fine-flake metallic above; the Real Racing 3 model's own black parts stay carbon, rims are its dark forged centre-lock wheels

bentley-gt.why: Continental GT: a deep, mirror-smooth fine metallic, bright silver multi-spoke wheels

bmw1.why: AMG GT4: fine-flake metallic over the model's own carbon and livery trim, black race wheels, green calipers as on the GT4 race car

buggati.why: Divo: deep metallic over hand-laid exposed carbon aero (the model's own carbon parts), forged wheels, Bugatti-blue calipers; the Chiron-style yellow calipers dropped with the Meshy shell

furari-488.why: 488 track car: deep solid gloss like rosso corsa, carbon splitter and sills, yellow calipers

jaguarxkjss.why: XKSS: 1950s deep solid enamel gloss, silver wire wheels, no carbon

ford-gt.why: Ford GT Mk II: track car in fine-flake gloss over the model's own carbon aero and decals, dark race wheels, red calipers

porsche1.why: 918 Spyder (Weissach look): fine-flake metallic over a black carbon lower body and engine deck, dark forged 20-inch multi-spoke wheels (the model's own), acid-green calipers as on the Weissach package

destrier.why: Destrier: a one-off Solitaire hypercar on the Bolide's carbon monocoque, near-black deep metallic with polished brightwork trim along the arches, black wheels with bright edges, gold-bronze calipers

blackbird.why: Blackbird: named for the SR-71, a naturally aspirated 6.2 V8 hypercar in deep solid gloss over exposed carbon aero (the model's own carbon parts), black five-spoke forged wheels, red calipers

laferrari.why: LaFerrari: Rosso Corsa-style deep solid gloss with a black roof and carbon lower aero (the model's own black parts), silver forged five-spoke wheels (the model's own), red calipers

huracan.why: Huracan STO: pearlescent gloss (Blu Laufey on the model) with a carbon bonnet centre and roof (the model's own black parts), carbon sills and aero, black forged 20-inch wheels; the model has no separate calipers (the disc is baked into the wheel), so the caliper colour waits for a model that has them

nissan-z.why: Nissan Z GT4: fine-flake metallic over the model's own carbon, red stripes and NISMO decals, black race wheels, red Brembo calipers as on the car

supra.why: GR Supra GT500: gloss metallic over the model's own red and black Gazoo Racing livery, number plate and carbon aero; the model has no separate calipers (the rims are baked), so the caliper colour waits for a model that has them

jesko.why: Jesko Attack: fine-flake gloss over the model's own carbon aero and lime accents, black wheels (the carbon spokes take the finish's rim colour), gold calipers

cc850.why: CC850: a deep metallic road car over the model's own carbon lower body and mirrors, its own dark five-spoke wheels, red calipers

zr1.why: ZR1: deep metallic over the model's own carbon roof, hood surround, splitter and ZTK wing; black rims (the spokes take the finish's rim colour), blue Brembo calipers as on the real car

stingray.why: Stingray: a metallic road car over the model's own black roof panel, side intakes and spoiler, its own machined five-spoke wheels (they keep their look), red calipers
